title: Task
description: One line of data/tasks/{train,test,hard,hard_train,hard_train_holdout}.jsonl. Gold answers come from the snapshot, never from a human. split hard is eval-only. split hard_train is the disjoint training pool for those templates and is not part of the default GRPO mix. split hard_train_holdout is a question-level slice of that pool (same drugs) that training must not load.

entity.description: The drug the task is about. Train/test split is by generic_name, so no drug appears in both.

answerable.description: false means the correct answer is NOT_FOUND (openFDA has no matching record).

difficulty.description: Computed from difficulty_features by the rule in docs/difficulty.md. Never hand-typed.

base_pass_rate.description: Fraction of 8 base-model samples with correctness > 0. null until calibrated.

value.description: The answer. For judge tasks, a reference answer the judge sees alongside the rubric.

aliases.description: Other strings that count as exact matches after normalization (e.g. DIARRHEA for DIARRHOEA).

keywords.description: For boolean tasks with a topic (boxed_warning): the answer is a string that starts with yes/no matching value and contains at least one keyword (case-insensitive).

tolerance.description: For number: relative tolerance for partial credit. 0 means exact only.

rubric.description: For judge: binary criteria, each scored 0 or 1.

gold_citations.description: Acceptable evidence. A citation is relevant if its endpoint matches and its field is in fields and (ids is empty or its id is in ids).

ids.description: Accepted record ids (e.g. all 74 warfarin set_ids). Empty means any record returned by a matching query.

oracle_calls.description: The tool calls (excluding submit_answer) that retrieve the gold evidence, in order. Its length is min_tool_calls. Used by the oracle integration test and to pre-fetch context for single-turn GRPO.
